Status: Supersedes the 2026-07-25 hand-written ROUTING.md. That version is the artifact this task (P3) was commissioned to fix: it was accurate at the time but had no regeneration mechanism, so nothing forced it to stay accurate. It also framed the I2 axis-agnostic storage refactor (`analysis_derivation` table, `pipeline/query_engine/axis_registry.py`) as future work ('superseded once I2 lands') when I2 had, by the time of generation, already landed -- exactly the kind of drift a hand-maintained routing doc cannot catch on its own. This file is regenerated by `tools/generate_routing.py`; a regeneration-diff gate in `scripts/validate_ssot_consistency.py` fails CI if it drifts from the committed file. To change routing content: edit the generator (for MEASURED sections) or this file (for EDITORIAL sections), then run `python3 tools/generate_routing.py --write` and commit the result. Never hand-edit ROUTING.md directly -- the next regeneration will silently discard hand edits, and the diff gate will catch (and reject) exactly that discrepancy in the meantime.

### 4b. Operational constraints — EDITORIAL (reviewed 2026-07-25; not safely re-triggerable every generation run)

- SQLite writes directly on the mounted repo FAIL with `disk I/O error`, and leave a stale `storage/parsed_dataset.db-journal` that then blocks *reads*. Correct procedure: (1) `cp storage/parsed_dataset.db /tmp/w.db` (2) mutate `/tmp/w.db` (3) `cat /tmp/w.db > storage/parsed_dataset.db` (4) `: > storage/parsed_dataset.db-journal` to truncate any stale journal. Not re-verified on every generation run: doing so would mean deliberately reproducing a mount corruption on every invocation of this generator, which is unacceptable even as a test.
- `rm` is not permitted on the mount. To discard a file, move it into a `_to_delete/` folder and say so.
- Each bash call is capped at 45 s and shares no cwd/env with the next. Batch long corpus runs and use absolute paths. Not re-verified each run: proving the cap requires deliberately exceeding it.
- The test suite has side effects: it writes `storage/backups/` and touches `storage/html_reports/202606_MATH_DIF_15_report.html`. Ignore or revert; do not "fix".

## 5. Verification commands

```bash
cd <repo>
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests          # full suite
python3 scripts/validate_ssot_consistency.py   # data + structural gate; exit 1 == real defect
python3 tools/generate_routing.py --check      # regeneration-diff gate for THIS file
```

Baseline discipline: diff test failures **by test NAME** against the recorded baseline, never by count (the count moves whenever anyone adds a test).

**Current measured gate result: `exit=0`** (0 error(s): none). 

## 6. Known-good anchors for sanity-checking any pipeline — MEASURED spot-check against live DB

- `202606_MATH_DIF_15` — answer 4, correct_value 27. Text should contain `\int_{p}^{p+3}∣f(x)∣dx≠∣\int_{p}^{p+3}f(x)dx∣`. **MATCHES live DB.** The one item with real (non-placeholder) analysis on all 8 axes -- the only place in the corpus where axis output can be checked against ground truth rather than just against 'is it a stub'.
- `202109_MATH_DIF_07` — answer 4, correct_value -3. Text should contain `\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{a_{k+1}-a_{k}}{a_{k}a_{k+1}}=\frac{1}{n}`. **MATCHES live DB.** Subscripts inside construct bodies (`a_{k+1}`, `a_{k}` nested under a `\sum`/`\frac`) are the historic HWP-parsing failure mode; check this item first after touching the layout reconstructor.

## 7. Open, unfixed

MEASURED (live, from `pipeline/query_engine/axis_registry.py` per-axis `notes`):
- `axis1_curriculum` (deprecated, kind=analyser): 2022 revised curriculum achievement standards, cross-unit coupling matrix, prerequisite graph. As of 2026-07-25, 3/1350 items (202606_MATH_{DIF,GEO,PRO}_15) carry real per-item analysis; the remaining 1,347 are the single-key placeholder sentinel {'objective': 'OBJ_UNDERSTAND'}.
- `axis3_symbolic_modeling` (deprecated, kind=analyser): Concept Map Integration depends on storage/kice_math_concept_map.json, which holds only 3 concepts -- this axis is structurally dead for the other 1,347 items regardless of analysis effort (ROUTING.md data-health note). 3/1350 items carry real analysis.
- `axis4_contextual_tree` (deprecated, kind=analyser): Records AGENT REASONING (backtrack_log trial-and-error telemetry), not a property of the item itself -- a category difference from the other analyser axes; do not treat it as item metadata. 0/1350 real; 1,347 are NULL (no stub JSON was ever written for this axis, unlike axis1/3/5/6).
- `axis5_traps_verification` (deprecated, kind=analyser): 16 student error codes, is_simulated_hypothesis / review_required / confidence_score. 3/1350 items carry real analysis.
- `axis6_genealogy` (deprecated, kind=analyser): 7 closed lineage relation enums, precedent_item_id foreign keys. 3/1350 items carry real analysis.
- `axis7_mutation` (deprecated, kind=generator): GENERATOR, not analyser: it tracks/produces mutated phrasing variants of an item's conditions rather than describing properties of the item as given. Classifying it as an analyser like the other 7 axes is a known category error in the current taxonomy. 0/1350 real; 1,347 NULL.
- `axis8_knowledge_graph` (deprecated, kind=derived): DERIVED from axes 1-7 (graph node/edge topology, degree centrality, cluster IDs computed over the other axes' output) and carries no independent signal of its own -- a second known category error. 0/1350 real; 1,347 NULL.
- `ce.segmentation` (under_review, kind=analyser): Cuts the item into atomic encoding units, including unlabelled global premises that sit outside the (가)/(나) markers but are load-bearing.
- `ce.semantics` (under_review, kind=analyser): What each unit constrains and which concept it attaches to. Fused deliberately: splitting object from concept reproduces the drift pattern this registry exists to remove. Runs concurrently per unit under a negative-context rule -- an instance may not see other units.
- `ce.relation` (under_review, kind=analyser): Relations among units: SEQUENTIAL_REFINEMENT, INDEPENDENT, IMPLICATION, MUTUAL_EXCLUSION, DUPLICATION, BACKGROUND_CONSTRAINT. Background constraints never become conclusion nodes or relatedness edges -- that classification is the primary defence against hub explosion.
- `ce.canonical` (under_review, kind=derived): Whether differently-expressed conclusions converge. DERIVED: consumes verified conclusions, so it must not be scheduled concurrently with the stages that produce them.
- `ce.variance` (under_review, kind=derived): How the same conclusion is encoded differently across the corpus. DERIVED, same scheduling constraint as ce.canonical.
- `ce.altgen` (under_review, kind=generator): GENERATOR, not an analyser: produces conditions that would force a given conclusion but were not observed. Every payload carries provenance_class SYNTHETIC and is excluded by default from variance and relatedness results.
